slot_note: wave 3, seed DQ15 (whether an item's published prevalence carries a misclassification flag); the seed's decision (which published prevalences carry the flag) and quantity (a prevalence corrected for the test's sensitivity and specificity) kept, the world moved to a district's post-season dengue IgM household serosurvey; the seed's pitfall (false positives ignored) is not the stump
niche: a city corporation's quality flags on the zone-level dengue infection shares it publishes from its post-season IgM household serosurvey, each zone's share read through an assay whose detection fades with the weeks since onset
answer: Six of the 12 zones' published 2027 dengue infection shares carry the misclassification flag (M): IV Melmangalam, V Vadakkupatti, VII Velliyanur, VIII Chinnakulam, IX Periyamalai and XI Sengalur; the other six zones' values go to the committee without the flag.
stakeholder_role: the city health officer's epidemiologist, who sets the quality flags on the indicators the corporation publishes

world.geography: India, a fictional city corporation in a southern state (Neithalpuram City Municipal Corporation, its 12 zones, the medical college laboratory that tests for it; real country and national surveillance programme)
world.org_type: municipal corporation public health department (city epidemiology cell)

driver: The decisive quantity is the share of units that experienced an event during a period, read through a detector whose chance of registering the event fades with the time since it happened, so each unit's detection rate is the detector's curve averaged over that unit's own spread of event times up to its reading date; correcting with the detector's rate measured on a validation set with another spread of times misstates the share unit by unit.
driver_concrete: Each zone's published IgM-positive share is meant to stand for the share of its residents infected with dengue since 1 January, but the assay detects nearly every infection in the weeks after onset and few after three months, so a zone's chance of testing positive is the assay's sensitivity curve by days since onset averaged over the zone's own epidemic curve up to each specimen's collection, which in zones surveyed months after their epidemic is a fraction of the sensitivity the laboratory's panel measures.
stump: A competent analyst corrects each zone's published IgM share by the Rogan-Gladen estimator with the laboratory panel's sensitivity from the fifth day of illness on (0.708) and its specificity, puts every zone between 1.00 and 1.30 times its published value and flags no zone; the step that lands it there is taking the panel's sensitivity as the assay's sensitivity in every zone, when the zones surveyed months after their epidemic had most of their 2027 infections past the weeks in which IgM is found, so only the panel's curve averaged over each zone's own onset dates up to collection gives the six.
analyst_test: A strong analyst who reads every file correctly and applies the flag rule as filed corrects each zone's IgM share by the Rogan-Gladen estimator with the panel's sensitivity from the fifth day of illness (0.708), pooled over the panel (0.677) or over the kit's 5 to 60 day window (0.868), and the panel's specificity, finds every corrected share between 0.82 and 1.37 times the published figure and flags no zone, where the golden flags six.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is each zone's dengue attack rate since January estimated from IgM serology the way serosurvey epidemiology estimates incidence from a recent-infection marker, through the marker's detection curve by days since onset convolved with the zone's own epidemic curve up to each specimen's collection; with hospital beds or megawatt-hours in place of residents, IgM and epidemic curves there is no marker kinetics and no transmission season for the effective sensitivity to come from, so the task stops making sense.
layer1: the case line list's dates written day-month-year, onset and notification dates days apart
zone names spelt as each hospital, health centre or laboratory writes them
the line list carrying the 2026 season's tail, non-residents and repeat notifications of one case
the panel's specimens with onset and collection dates and grey-zone readings repeated
participants' specimens collected across each zone's eleven-day fieldwork
the November inspection forms switching to the new ward numbers mid-month (ask A)
a warm cool box's haemolysed sera and the field app's resent submissions (ask B)

differentiation.task229: task229 (v2, lineage) reads a state share through checks whose timing is set by the state itself; task242 reads an infection share through a marker whose detection fades with the time since infection, carried through each zone's own epidemic curve: no selection of when units are seen, no shared quantity or file
differentiation.task461: task461 sets a dial from a low quantile carried to a short record through a correlated auxiliary series; task242 corrects a share for a detection rate that varies with time since the event: no quantile, no auxiliary series, no dial
differentiation.task501: task501 (v4) picks the group that keeps a reproduction eigenvalue above one under the season's contact regime; task242 estimates each zone's attack rate through IgM kinetics and the zone's epidemic timing: same field, a different quantity, no contact matrix
differentiation.task230: task230 (v2, lineage) has a detector's hit rate falling as targets thin in a shared pool; task242's detection falls with the time since each event and is averaged over each zone's own event times: no pool, no prevalence-dependence

notes: Seed DQ15: the decision (which published prevalences carry the misclassification flag) and the quantity (a prevalence corrected for the assay's accuracy) kept; the seed's survey world and its pitfall (false positives ignored) are not used. The decisive step is the field's own: an IgM serosurvey's attack rate since January needs the assay's detection curve by days since onset carried through each zone's own epidemic timing, which the panel's single sensitivity does not describe.
